title: Explain contextual transaction weekdays and regional holidays
reason:
User orders,rentals or invoices specify location,event timestamp and optional timezone. Proposed place→IANA zone and explicit local-date policy lead to CLDR week conventions and jurisdiction holiday events. Ask weekend versus holiday counts and which rows lack timezone/jurisdiction. Visuals: calendar heatmap and unresolved grid. GOVUK2019–2028 overlaps Chinook but not Northwind2016–2018 or Pubs1992–1994. UK alone cannot choose Scotland or England/Wales. Naive timestamps need event-zone policy; Employees9999 is a validity sentinel,not a holiday observation. Historical holiday sources remain a gap.

Phase 2 context reviewed: scenario; directly attached assertion dispositions are enumerated in p2-coverage.json. Member/dependency IDs preserved. Each unresolved/rejected mapping, source rights and temporal/domain gap remains a readiness prerequisite; no portfolio selection or executable bundle acceptance.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
